decisive_items: Subepidermal infiltrate consisting of large cells with kidney-shaped nuclei
The infiltrate stained positively for CD1A
Two osteolytic lesions identified on the right frontoparietal skull
response.rationale: CD1A positivity and kidney-shaped nuclei are diagnostic of Langerhans cell histiocytosis, supported by osteolytic skull lesions and scalp involvement. R1 is a broader category and lacks the specific CD1A-based confirmation.

rejected.why: Histiocytosis is too nonspecific; the CD1A-positive infiltrate and clinical/imaging findings point specifically to Langerhans cell histiocytosis.
